technical.summary: Long-term trend structure is bullish with strong moving average alignment, but momentum indicators lack conviction; MACD remains negative and price is below short-term EMAs, suggesting caution on swing entry timing.

fundamental.summary: IRM shows no insider buying conviction, no institutional accumulation signals, zero government contracts, no lobbying activity, minimal retail interest, and elevated earnings risk within 66 days.

sentiment.summary: Extreme market fear (34 VIX-equivalent) presents contrarian buy opportunity, but congressional activity is minimal and mixed with no senior conviction buying.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: inverted yield curve signals recession risk, VIX at crisis levels (315.36) indicates extreme market stress, rising DXY pressures multinationals, and credit spreads likely elevated; IRM faces compounded cyclical and liquidity risks despite 66-day earnings buffer.

debate.key_bull_argument: Long-term trend structure is bullish (EMA 50/200 aligned, price above SMA 200, Supertrend bullish, Ichimoku above cloud) with extreme fear (VIX crisis) presenting contrarian opportunity and price near support (46.89) offering defined risk entry.
debate.key_bear_argument: Momentum is broken (MACD negative, price below EMA 9/Hull MA, no triggered strategies), fundamental conviction is absent (zero insider/institutional buying, high earnings risk in 66 days), and macro environment is severely adverse (inverted yield curve, DXY headwind, credit stress) making this a contrarian trap rather than opportunity.

decision.entry_rationale: While long-term trend structure is bullish and extreme fear presents contrarian opportunity, momentum is broken (MACD negative, price below short-term EMAs) and fundamental conviction is entirely absent with high earnings risk in 66 days.
decision.primary_risk: Macro environment is severely adverse (inverted yield curve, VIX crisis, DXY headwind, credit stress) creating cyclical headwinds that could trigger sharp reversal despite technical support; earnings in 66 days adds binary risk.
decision.agent_agreement: moderate — technical and sentiment agents show bullish lean, but fundamental and risk agents strongly oppose; debate winner is bear with medium confidence.
